statement.text: Successful people tend to ask the same question: am I doing what I need to be doing? Our work is to help you answer it with a confident yes, and then help you decide what comes next.

pillars.title: One coordinated plan
pillars.text: Your investments, banking, insurance, taxes and estate plan are reviewed together, so every decision supports the outcomes that matter most to you.

pillars.title: Reviewed on a schedule
pillars.text: Regularly scheduled conversations surface the actions your plan needs as your career, family and the markets change, so you always know the next step.

pillars.title: Wealth with a purpose
pillars.text: Once the foundations are secure, we help you connect your resources to your values, from how you live today to what you leave for your family and community.

disciplines.title: Five disciplines. One plan holding them together.
disciplines.lead: Most people handle these areas separately, with different people and no shared goal. We plan them as one structure, built on history, analysis and research, with your goals at the top.
disciplines.hint: Point to or tap a discipline to light its column

image.alt: Line drawing of a classical temple. Five columns labeled cash flow, investments, tax planning, insurance and estate planning hold up a roof labeled goals and minimum outcomes, standing on a base of history, analysis and research.

items.name: Cash flow & banking
items.text: A clear view of what comes in, what goes out and where the margin should go, so saving happens by design.

items.name: Investments
items.text: Portfolios built around the goals and timelines in your plan, not around the headlines of the week.

items.name: Tax planning
items.text: Saving, investing and giving decisions made with their tax impact in view, coordinated with your tax professional.

items.name: Insurance
items.text: Coverage reviewed against what your family and business would actually need, so one setback does not undo the plan.

items.name: Estate planning
items.text: Guidance on how your wealth is held and passed on, working alongside your attorney to keep documents and intentions aligned.

process.title: Straightforward guidance in three stages.
process.lead: Every client relationship follows the same path. Where you begin depends on where you are today.

stages.name: Freedom
stages.headline: Protect your time and your resources.
text: We work with you to build a proactively managed plan that supports your most important financial outcomes, such as retirement and education.
Through a systematic review process and regularly scheduled conversations, we uncover the actions your plan needs as things change across all five disciplines.

image.alt: Line drawing of a classical temple whose five columns represent the five disciplines of planning.

stages.name: Purpose
stages.headline: Move from managing wealth to using it well.
text: Once long term goals are on track, many clients ask: what's next?
The Purpose stage takes you from wealth management to wealth utilization. It reconnects your resources with your values, so your wealth helps you live well today and tomorrow.

image.alt: Line drawing of three goblets pouring into one another, labeled value of labor, savings and quality of life.

stages.name: Legacy
stages.headline: Make an impact that outlasts you.
text: Many of our clients want their wealth to improve the lives of others, but choosing where to invest in that impact, and through which vehicles, can be hard to navigate.
The Legacy stage guides you as you put your resources to work for family and philanthropic ventures.

image.alt: Line drawing of an oak tree. The roots are labeled family capital, the trunk family bank and the canopy ventures.

audiences.title: Built for people who are building something.
audiences.lead: Our clients are at different points in life, but they share a sense of responsibility for what they have and for the people who come after them.

items.name: First generation wealth creators
items.question: Am I doing what I need to be doing?
items.text: You have taken responsibility and worked hard to get where you are. We make sure the answer to that question is yes, then help you with the one that follows: so what's next?

items.name: Next generation family leaders
items.question: How do I carry this forward?
items.text: As a family grows with each generation, ownership becomes more complex. We help you understand and fulfill the role you have been called to play in your family's continued prosperity.

items.name: Entrepreneurs
items.question: Does my business plan provide for my family?
items.text: You may not fit inside the box, and to you wealth is the value you create, not a number on a statement. We help you build a plan for your business that also provides for your family.

items.name: Emerging leaders
items.question: How do I make the most of my trajectory?
items.text: You may not own a business or come from money, but you have trajectory and you are eager to invest in yourself. We help you understand the value you create and build a plan to grow it.

team.title: A practice with a coach at its heart.
team.quote: Elliot's planning philosophy grew out of years of coaching, and that habit of patient, practical encouragement is still the heart of the practice.

lead.name: Elliot Marsh, MBA, CFP®
bio: Elliot grew up in southern Wisconsin, studied economics at a state university and earned his MBA while working in corporate finance. He is a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ professional and a committed lifelong learner.
He coached high school cross-country for a decade and serves on the boards of a community foundation and a youth mentoring program.

member.name: Sofia Brennan
member.bio: Sofia holds degrees in human resources and economics, graduating with honors. She makes sure every client feels known, from the first call to the annual review.

start.title: Three steps to a clear plan.

steps.title: An introductory conversation
steps.text: Tell us where you are, what you are working toward and the questions on your mind. We will tell you honestly whether we are the right fit.

steps.title: Your Freedom plan
steps.text: We review all five disciplines together and build a coordinated plan with clear, prioritized next steps.

steps.title: Ongoing reviews
steps.text: Regularly scheduled conversations keep the plan current and open the door to the Purpose and Legacy stages when you are ready.
